name: textarea
description: The themed multi-line text input: a native <textarea> with the look, a visible focus ring and a destructive border/ring on aria-invalid. Owns no label or error markup — pair it with field.

notes: A native <textarea> — focusable and labellable by default; give it a label via field or htmlFor
Shows a visible focus-visible ring for keyboard users

intents: a comment, bio or message field
the control inside a field wrapper for long text
